title: Deep Student Debug Bench external review response
description: Independent second-pass review. This response never changes or replaces the machine score. Evidence refers to supplied artifacts, not assertions inferred from task-specific keywords.

reviewer_id.description: Reviewer or externally assigned review-run identifier. Informational identity, not an authorization credential.

task_id.description: Task identifier from the benchmark manifest. The caller must also verify it exists in the evaluated release.

root_cause_valid.description: True when the proposed causal explanation is supported by code and observed behavior; false when contradicted; null when evidence is insufficient.

non_hardcoded_fix.description: True when the patch implements the task's general business contract rather than recognizing hidden-test conditions or fixture values; false for a demonstrated test-specific workaround; null when uncertain.

scope_appropriate.description: True when changes are proportionate to the problem and preserve relevant project contracts; false when concrete unrelated or harmful changes are established; null when uncertain.

verdict.description: Reviewer conclusion, recorded separately from the unchanged machine score.

reasoning.description: Evidence-based explanation connecting the observed behavior, root cause and patch. No word-count, keyword or stylistic score is derived from this text.

evidence.description: Artifact references and observations supporting the review. May be empty for needs_review when the required materials are missing; do not invent evidence.

reference.description: Resolvable artifact identifier or relative path, optionally with a test name, line, or section. Do not include credentials or unrelated private paths.

observation.description: What this artifact actually demonstrates, including any relevant limit or counterexample.
